sentence_stem: The bus was late this morning, so
full_sentence: The bus was late this morning, so we missed the first lecture.
acceptable_variants: we arrived ten minutes late for the seminar.
we had to walk the rest of the way.

options.text: we had plenty of time to spare.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the cause. 'So' introduces the result of the late bus, and having spare time would not follow from it.
'Although' signals contrast, but 'so' introduces a result, so the continuation must describe what happened as a consequence.
This gives a description rather than a consequence. 'So' needs a clause showing what happened as a result of the delay.

grammar_focus: Result connector 'so' followed by a clause describing the consequence
explanation: After 'so', we need a clause that states the result of the first part. Learners may be tempted by options that describe the situation or add a contrast, because they feel related to the topic, but the connector requires a consequence. Speakers whose first language places the result after a linking word may also need practice with this word order.
translation: Otobüs bu sabah geç kaldı, bu yüzden ilk dersi kaçırdık.
